name: Dewberry

facts.how: Raw by the handful, cobbler, jam
facts.where: Sunny ditches, fence rows, old fields

caution: Low trailing canes are thorny, and so are the chiggers that share the patch. Tuck pant legs in and wash up after.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: Dewberries run along the ground, not up canes like blackberries, and ripen weeks earlier. Pick dead-black fruit that pulls free without a tug; red ones will only teach you patience.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: The first quart rarely makes it home. Those that do want a cobbler, or a jam loose enough to remember the fruit.
